response.justification: Despite extensive senior-level experience, the candidate lacks entry-level alignment with the role: they have no demonstrable Java-focused project experience in the last 7+ years, German proficiency is only basic (a hard requirement), and their career trajectory suggests overqualification with potential misalignment in seniority and motivation for an entry-level position.
strengths: Extensive full-stack engineering experience across multiple languages and domains
Strong contributions to open-source and community-driven tech education
Proven track record in agile practices, CI/CD, and test-driven development
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, failing to meet the required fluency
No recent Java experience despite Java being a core requirement
Senior-level title and 15+ years of experience suggest overqualification and potential misfit for junior role
